answer: Make every operator pay a bond that grows quadratically with each identity it controls: the first locks 40 POA, the second 160, the third 360, so the marginal cost of one more fake rises steeply instead of staying flat. A public beacon lists the bond cluster of each funding source, and auditors sample one identity per cluster each epoch, slashing the whole bond if any fails its work check. An honest agent pays one small bond and keeps its weight; a sybil farm faces a basalt wall of compounding cost, while the beacon's sable ledger makes hidden clusters visible before rewards vest.
